q1_issues.issue: The Implication contains no variables at all - its premises are ground atoms over sk_maintain_1 / sk_rate_1, which are asserted nowhere in the parse, so the rule can never fire and the sentence's only claim is unretrievable; the instruction set requires a rule to range over a variable with a Skolem-function event term such as (sk_maintain $x).

"the results" is a presupposed definite plural, but its (GroupOf sk_result_1 result) typing sits inside the rule's consequent, so the group exists only if the (unfirable) rule fires rather than standing as an asserted fact.

The plural descriptive modifier "comparable" is predicated of the group witness as (Member sk_rate_1 comparable) instead of distributing over the members like a copular predicate, and "the results are high" likewise gets no distributive rule alongside the group atom.

q2_gaps: noun + of-complement nominal ("rates of flow"): it is not a modifier_noun compound and not a possessive, partitive, measure or about of-phrase, so nothing licenses fusing it into rate_of_flow (or says how else to attach the complement) - only the genus half of the compound rule transfers

generic conditional "P when <clause>": the ConditionalProperty template ("X is P when/at/under/if C") is defined only for an adjective/state or measure/environment condition, and the plain-Implication route says nothing about how a definite-plural copular consequent and its required distribution are encoded inside a rule
notes: Lexically the parse is sound - Theme for "maintained", (Can e) for the modal passive, and the rate genus at definitional TV - so the failure is purely quantificational. A companion query for either clause would bind nothing, because every symbol in the rule is a constant introduced only inside the rule.
